Running `go vet ./...` and `go test ./...` in the container.
Added [`Encode`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-tnidj3op/s2/shapeindex.go#L1651-L1733) and [`Decode`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-tnidj3op/s2/shapeindex.go#L1737-L1917) on [`ShapeIndex`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-tnidj3op/s2/shapeindex.go#L592-L638) in branch `shapeindex-encode-decode`.

### Summary of Changes
- **`ShapeIndex` Serialization ([`s2/shapeindex.go`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-tnidj3op/s2/shapeindex.go))**:
  - [`ShapeIndex.Encode`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-tnidj3op/s2/shapeindex.go#L1651-L1733) builds any pending updates via [`ShapeIndex.Build`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-tnidj3op/s2/shapeindex.go#L798-L800), then writes the encoding version, `maxEdgesPerCell`, `nextID`, all active `(shapeID, shape)` pairs in ascending ID order, all spatial index cells (`CellID` and [`clippedShape`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-tnidj3op/s2/shapeindex.go#L121-L133) entries with `shapeID`, `containsCenter`, and `edges`), and a 4-byte IEEE CRC32 checksum.
  - [`ShapeIndex.Decode`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-tnidj3op/s2/shapeindex.go#L1737-L1917) validates the stream header, shape IDs, shapes, cell ordering/validity, clipped shape references, and CRC32 trailer with capped initial slice/map allocations (`maxInitialShapeIndexAlloc`) and element bounds (`maxEncodedShapeIndexElements`), restoring the index in a `fresh` state ready for iteration and queries without calling [`Build`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-tnidj3op/s2/shapeindex.go#L798-L800).
  - Round-trips all built-in [`Shape`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-tnidj3op/s2/shape.go#L184-L269) implementations ([`*Polygon`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-tnidj3op/s2/polygon.go#L52-L81), [`*Polyline`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-tnidj3op/s2/polyline.go#L35), [`*PointVector`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-tnidj3op/s2/point_vector.go#L29), [`*LaxPolyline`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-tnidj3op/s2/lax_polyline.go#L27-L29), [`*LaxPolygon`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-tnidj3op/s2/lax_polygon.go#L65-L75), [`*Loop`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-tnidj3op/s2/loop.go#L45-L69), [`*LaxLoop`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-tnidj3op/s2/lax_loop.go#L28-L31)) as well as non-standard [`Shape`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-tnidj3op/s2/shape.go#L184-L269) types via [`genericShape`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-tnidj3op/s2/shapeindex.go#L1615-L1648).
  - Fixed non-contiguous shape ID handling in [`ShapeIndex.applyUpdatesInternal`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-tnidj3op/s2/shapeindex.go#L844-L876), [`ShapeIndex.makeIndexCell`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-tnidj3op/s2/shapeindex.go#L1161-L1273), and [`CrossingEdgeQuery.candidatesEdgeMap`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-tnidj3op/s2/crossing_edge_query.go#L182-L246).
- **`Shape` Method Fixes**:
  - Fixed [`LaxLoop.ChainEdge`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-tnidj3op/s2/lax_loop.go#L74-L80) wrap-around condition (`j+1 != l.numVertices`).
  - Fixed [`LaxPolygon.ChainPosition`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-tnidj3op/s2/lax_polygon.go#L206-L221) chain index calculation (`nextLoop - 1`).
  - Fixed [`PointVector.ChainEdge`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-tnidj3op/s2/point_vector.go#L36) degenerate point indexing.
- **Tests ([`s2/shapeindex_test.go`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-tnidj3op/s2/shapeindex_test.go))**:
  - Added tests for empty index round-trip, all shape types, non-contiguous shape IDs after removals, zero-edge shapes and mixed chain counts, encoding unbuilt/mutated indexes, and malformed/truncated/corrupted/oversized decode inputs.
